```sql
-- Budget by department (example)
SELECT
  d.department_id,
  d.department_name,
  SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget
FROM departments d
JOIN budgets b
  ON b.department_id = d.department_id
-- Optional filters:
-- WHERE b.fiscal_year = 2026
--   AND b.status = 'APPROVED'
GROUP BY
  d.department_id,
  d.department_name
ORDER BY
  d.department_name;
```
